restaurant: Mana Mana Plant-Based Tel Aviv Street Food

items.name: Psychedelic Cauliflower
items.description: Whole roasted caramelized cauliflower head with green tahini, grated tomato, pomegranate molasses, chili.
items.allergen_notes: Sesame tahini emulsion. Gluten-free, Nut-free, 100% Vegan.

items.name: Mana Shakshuka with Feta
items.description: Rich spiced tomato and roasted red pepper stew with poached farm eggs, Greek feta, fresh pita.
items.allergen_notes: Pita flatbread contains wheat gluten; feta contains sheep milk dairy.

items.name: Warm Hummus with Wild Mushrooms
items.description: Warm creamy chickpea hummus topped with sauteed king oyster mushrooms, pine nuts, sumac, pita.
items.allergen_notes: Tahini contains sesame; garnish contains pine nuts; served with wheat pita.
